data.description:
Observed in Live External Integration run 32568560934 (workflow_dispatch on main, 2026-08-22T10:47Z), job "external LLM (live bedrock)" (97020653007), failed after 12m27s. 17/18 live tests passed; one behavioral oracle failed in all 3 trials.

Failure:
tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:183
test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials
AssertionError: dense completion banking successes=0/3
Every trial returned: {"banked": 5, "verdict": "PASS", "error": None, "calls_at_bank": [11, 11, 11, 11, 11], "evidence_calls": 11}
assert 0 >= 2 — _bounded_bank_gaps(trial, expected_criteria=5) rejected all three trials.

Symptom analysis (unverified leads, for Phase 1):
- All 5 criteria banked and the verdict is PASS, but every criterion banked at call 11 — the final evidence call — instead of progressively as evidence accumulated. The oracle _bounded_bank_gaps expects bounded gaps between banking events (incremental banking), and all-at-the-end violates it in every trial (deterministic across 3 trials, not a flake pattern).
- Test name references ticket 0707 — read that ticket + its fix commit for the original banking contract before hypothesizing.
- Candidate directions (to falsify, not assume): a change in the completion-verifier loop now defers banking to the final call (behavioral regression against the 0707 contract); or the trial harness/counter changed so calls_at_bank records the final call number rather than the banking call; or the dense scenario's evidence schedule changed (11 calls where the oracle assumed more spread).
- Note this ran on live Bedrock (us-east-1, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION set); anthropic arm passed the same suite — check whether the anthropic arm ran this test or skipped it, as that discriminates model-behavior vs code-mechanism.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Root cause proven per the rebar-debug protocol: is banking genuinely all-at-the-end (mechanism regression), or is the measurement/oracle wrong? Runtime evidence required (a driven local trial with a stub or recorded transcript), not source reading alone.
- [ ] defect_legitimacy cited against the 0707 ticket's contract (banking must be incremental with bounded gaps).
- [ ] caused_by attributed via git history over the completion-verifier banking path since the last green run of this test.
- [ ] Fix lands RED->GREEN if a defect; if the oracle is wrong, the test is corrected under the strict test-modification order (revert fix, fix test, re-verify RED).
- [ ] Flaky-vs-deterministic explicitly quantified (3/3 trials failed identically here — confirm determinism locally).
data.title: Dense completion banking banks all criteria at final call, oracle 0/3
